name: steam_turbine_n2_compressor
title: Steam turbine driving a nitrogen compressor (exercise 5.54)
summary: An adiabatic steam turbine (4 MPa, 350 °C to 20 kPa, x = 0.95) delivers 42 kW to a nitrogen compressor and the rest to a generator. First law on two control volumes: generator power and heat rejected by the nitrogen, with a real-fluid vs ideal-gas comparison.

Maximum relative difference 3.25e-03 on W_dot_gen, from the steam inlet enthalpy (EES 8.4 water tables vs CoolProp, each h within 5e-04); all other variables within 2.8e-04.
